records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the fiscal 2023 quarter ended June 30, 2022 were $220,287,000, up $6,823,000 or 3.2% from the fiscal 2022 quarter ended June 30, 2021 net sales of $213,464,000.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: To date, we have raised prices to our customers to cover these increased raw material costs and are working with our supply base to prioritize shipments and improve availability of key components.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: An increase of $21,467,000 in inventories due to current supply chain constraints, a decrease of $15,720,000 in trade payables, and a decrease of $9,389,000 in accrued expenses and non-current liabilities contributed to cash used by operations.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our principal raw materials and components purchases were approximately $368 million in fiscal 2022 (or 62% of Cost of product sold) and include steel, consisting of rod, wire, bar, structural, and other forms of steel; electric motors; bearings; gear reducers; castings; steel and aluminum enclosures and wire harnesses; electro-mechanical components; and standard variable drives and controls.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used by operating activities was $11,177,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2022 compared to $7,396,000 for the three months ended June 30, 2021.
